Warehousing

พื้นที่จัดเตรียม

A designated space within a warehouse where goods are temporarily held for inspection, consolidation, or preparation before shipment, receiving, or internal movement.

Quick answer: A designated space within a warehouse where goods are temporarily held for inspection, consolidation, or preparation before shipment, receiving, or internal movement.

Questions and answers

What is พื้นที่จัดเตรียม?

In this glossary, พื้นที่จัดเตรียม refers to: A designated space within a warehouse where goods are temporarily held for inspection, consolidation, or preparation before shipment, receiving, or internal movement.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A designated space within a warehouse where goods are temporarily held for inspection, consolidation, or preparation before shipment, receiving, or internal movement.

Operational example

Products are placed in the staging area for final quality control before loading onto outbound trucks or containers.

Localized term
